links.outcome: Agreement of AI auto-contours with local manual contours, geometric and dosimetric
links.effect: Intact-breast AC V95% 97.1% vs MC 98.4% (p=0.02); IMN V90% significantly different; only 62.5% of AC-CWs met ΔV95%<5% when DSC>0.7 vs 94.1% for breasts.
links.quote: Before clinical implementation of this auto-segmentation software, an in-depth assessment of agreement with each local facilities MCs is needed.

links.outcome: Need for clinician review of AI contours for post-mastectomy chestwall and IMN
links.effect: AC post-mastectomy CW and IMN showed dosimetric disagreement (IMN V90% significant; only 62.5% AC-CWs met ΔV95%<5%), so careful review is recommended; AxN and SC may need manual adjustment.
links.quote: Careful review should be performed for AC post-mastectomy CW and IMN before treatment planning.

unlisted_practices: Using geometric thresholds (DSC>0.7) to predict dosimetric acceptability of auto-contours

screen.reason: Evaluates the geometric and dosimetric accuracy of an AI auto-segmentation tool against manual contours on retrospective patient data, but does not test a specific deployment safeguard or practice intervention.
